title: Cosmic Turtle Rider
description: A surreal black-and-white illustration with selective color shows a bespectacled man in a hat and patterned coat riding a giant turtle through space. The turtle has glowing yellow eyes and shell details, while the man holds a small red planet on a stick; above them floats a white astronaut, purple flowers, geometric shapes, and other celestial bodies against a starry black background.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene in black and white with selective purple yellow and red accents, a man wearing glasses a fedora and patterned coat riding a giant sea turtle through space, the turtle has glowing yellow eyes and purple shell patterns, the man holds a small red planet on a stick like a lollipop, above him a white astronaut walks along a white line, hanging purple flowers, floating geometric triangles, a small turtle in a space suit, planets and stars in a black void, intricate linework, whimsical and dreamlike atmosphere
medium: digital art with ink and color accents
